notes: Producer ReportLab 5.0.1 Platypus. Fonts Helvetica and Helvetica-Bold, standard-14, NOT embedded. Letterhead (three lines) and footer are drawn on every page by a page callback; the letterhead name is not a heading. The first table is a key/value block with no header row (rows are [label, value]). The totals rows (Subtotal, Delivery, VAT, Total due) are rows of the items table whose label cell spans the first four columns, so the label is repeated in those four cells. The bullet markers are typed U+2022 glyphs. The currency sign is the pound sign U+00A3.
